A note from the studio

Where stories
find their place.

“A good map tells you where you are. A great one makes you want to go.”

Meridian is an imaginary cartography studio devoted to the art of noticing. We draw landscapes with a sense of place, a little poetry, and plenty of room for the unexpected. Each map in this fictional atlas is an invitation to explore.

has a story.

We start with the shape of a place, then follow its character: the bend in a river, the rise of a hill, the road that takes the long way home.

Our maps are equal parts careful observation and an appetite for possibility.
